text_blocks.snippet: "CR" in the context of cancer typically stands for Complete Response. This means that in response to treatment, all signs of cancer have disappeared. It's a term used in clinical trials and treatment monitoring to indicate the effectiveness of a particular therapy. In the context of colorectal cancer, CR signifies the absence of detectable cancer after treatment.

list.title: Complete Response (CR):
list.snippet: In cancer treatment, a complete response (CR) indicates that all signs of cancer have disappeared following treatment, according to medical reference sources. This includes both the primary tumor and any metastases.
